sources.title: Seed 2.0 Official Launch
sources.evidence: Dated February 14, 2026; introduces Pro/Lite/Mini plus Code and explicitly says Pro launched in Doubao, with the full series API on Volcano Engine.

sources.title: Seed2.0 product page
sources.evidence: Identifies Seed2.0 Pro and its long-chain reasoning/workflow role. The late-April audio/omni upgrade is explicitly attributed to Lite, not Pro.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity
sources.evidence: June 30, 2026 arXiv v1; downloaded and text-extracted after web PDF size failure. Pro-specific language, image/video and agent evaluations support capabilities. No total/active parameter count or production architecture disclosure found in this report.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card: Agentic Intelligence for Productivity
sources.evidence: Later first-party card downloaded from the official Seed2.1 page and text-extracted. Checked for retrospective Seed2.0 Pro specifications; no total/active counts or architecture disclosure for that exact model was found. Seed2.1 specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Volcano Ark model list
sources.evidence: Current page fetched directly; read embedded MDContent after web rendering failed. Exact doubao-seed-2-0-pro-260215 rows specify 256k context, 224k input, 128k answer, deep thinking, text generation, visual understanding and tool calling. It is marked impending retirement; documentation does not prove endpoint operation.

sources.title: Doubao model service agreement
sources.evidence: Directly fetched embedded Markdown. Sections 1.2 and 2.2-2.3 grant limited nontransferable service use, retain model intellectual property and prohibit extracting model parameters; supports proprietary service classification.

sources.title: Official Seed2.0 API cookbook repository
sources.evidence: Provides model card and API examples requiring a Volcano Engine API key, rather than a downloadable Pro checkpoint. Apache-2.0 expressly licenses this cookbook repository; it does not establish an open-weight model license.

sources.title: Public Summary of Training Data Content for Seed 2.0 Pro
sources.evidence: Updated July 31, 2026. Identifies Seed 2.0-Pro/Dola-Seed-2.0-Pro and ByteDance; lists text, image and video training content, audio N/A. March 2026 refers specifically to EU market placement, not initial worldwide release. Training tokens/images/hours are not model parameter counts.

sources.title: DescribeBaasAIModels official API example: Doubao-Seed-2.0-pro
sources.evidence: Indexed first-party API example identifies exact Pro as the flagship general model for multimodal reasoning and long agent tasks. Its 260215 notes specify minimal/low/medium/high reasoning effort; minimal disables thinking. Direct rendered page returned no body.

name.note: Official Pro variant; spacing normalized to the catalog style.

developer.note: ByteDance Seed develops the model; transparency disclosure identifies ByteDance Nexus AI as provider.

family.note: Seed2.0 belongs to the Seed foundation-model family.

release_date.note: Initial public launch. The 260215 API suffix and March EU placement do not replace this date.

open_weights.note: Official distribution is hosted products/API under proprietary terms; no Pro weight release found in the reviewed official materials.

license.note: Descriptive model/service license classification. Cookbook Apache-2.0 is not a Pro weight license.

parameters_b.note: No Pro total count disclosed in the reviewed original/later cards or transparency summary; training-data quantities are not parameters.

active_parameters_b.note: No Pro active count disclosed in the reviewed model cards. No inference from variant names or sibling models.

architecture.note: No production architecture disclosed for exact Pro in the reviewed reports or targeted first-party architecture/interpretability searches; dense/MoE and Transformer labels remain unsupported.

context_window.note: Provider publishes 256k; retain nominal decimal normalization, not an asserted exact binary token limit. Input and output caps are separate.

modalities.note: Pro has text/image/video understanding and text generation. No audio input claim is transferred from later Lite/Mini revisions.

reasoning.note: Exact Pro endpoint documents deep thinking and adjustable reasoning effort.

tool_call.note: Exact provider row supports tool calling; Pro agent evaluations corroborate tool use.

description.value: ByteDance Seed 2.0 model for multimodal reasoning and tool-assisted tasks.
description.note: Plain summary of documented capabilities, with revision qualification where applicable.

patch.notes: Provider context is advertised as 256k; 256000 is nominal decimal normalization. The original doubao-seed-2-0-pro-260215 endpoint is marked impending retirement in current Ark documentation. Parameter counts and architecture remain undisclosed in the reviewed first-party reports. The cookbook Apache-2.0 license does not license model weights.
patch.description: ByteDance Seed 2.0 model for multimodal reasoning and tool-assisted tasks.

summary: All 14 fields assessed. Adds proprietary classification and primary provenance; confirms February 14 launch, nominal 256k context, text/image/video input, text output, reasoning and tools. Total/active counts and architecture remain undisclosed after checking the June Seed2.0 report and later Seed2.1 card. Notes impending API retirement without asserting live endpoint availability.
